items.title: Spec it safe: shift left and harden your specs with security requirements
items.en_title: Spec it safe: shift left and harden your specs with security requirements
items.en_oneliner: Kiro explains how spec-driven development can bake security requirements into the spec up front, so an AI coding agent follows it through design and tasks instead of leaving it all to one prompt.

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.en_title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
